study.title: Deep learning based coronary vessels segmentation in X-ray angiography using temporal information

imaging.modality_detail: Invasive coronary angiography (ICA) X-ray sequences; 4-frame short sequences per annotated frame
imaging.frames_per_sequence: 4 (two before and one after each annotated frame)

public_dataset_used.detail: Public 323-sample ICA dataset from Hao et al. (2020), Renji Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (D1)

data_released.detail: Data will be made available on request (private D2: 60 sequences from 39 patients, John Radcliffe Hospital, Oxford)

annotation.annotator_expertise: expert (D2 annotation and fine-grained re-segmentation of 10 test samples)

task.task_description: Segmentation of the coronary vessel tree in a target ICA frame using 4 consecutive frames via a 3D encoder-2D decoder (TVS-Net) with elastic-interaction energy loss and deep supervision; skeleton completeness/correctness also evaluated.
task.clinical_application: Aiding diagnosis of coronary artery disease/stenosis and treatment planning; vessel skeletons for 3D reconstruction

temporal_evidence.quote: the 3D encoder captures both spatial and temporal features from ICA sequences, treating time as a third dimension to enhance vessel segmentation

evaluation.external_validation_detail: Model trained on D1 (SJTU) applied without retraining to D2: 60 ICA sequences from 39 patients at John Radcliffe Hospital, Oxford

G1.quote: the size of available annotated ICA datasets often constrains the coronary vessels segmentation performance

G2.quote: We additionally perform an external evaluation over 60 images from a local hospital

G3.quote: we hypothesize that introducing temporal information is fundamental for solving motion-related challenges without complex motion modeling

G4.quote: In ICA, the acquired vascular structures always overlap with background structures.

G5.quote: manual annotation of the entire vascular tree, especially the thin vessels, is time-consuming and difficult due to human errors

G9.quote: primarily because dataset D 1 comprises only about 25% of RCA images

other_limitations: Datasets built from selected high-quality frames; performance on low-quality frames not demonstrated
Small private external dataset with random case selection increases variance
Hyperparameters optimized on the public dataset only
TVS-Net+ batch size limited by GPU resources
future_work: Combine with vascular post-processing techniques to further enhance segmentation quality
Explore time-performance trade-off between manual and automatic segmentation in annotation protocols
Elucidate impact of partially segmented ground truth on trained segmentation quality
